subject: civics
question_text: In a democracy why is universal adult franchise important?
answer_text:
Universal Adult Franchise is important in democracy as:
(i) It is based on the principle of equality.
(ii) It means that all adult (those who are 18 and above) citizens have the equal right to vote.
(iii) It do not discriminate on the basis of social or economic backgrounds.
(iv) It is an important aspects of democratic societies.
final_answer: Thus, universal adult franchise ensures equality and inclusiveness in the democratic process.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of democratic principles and their implications.

subject: civics
question_text: Re-read the box on Article 15 and state two ways in which this Article addresses inequality?
answer_text:
Two ways in which Article 15 addresses inequality:
(i) It suggests States not to discriminate against any citizen on grounds only of religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth or any of them.
(ii) No citizen shall be subject to any disability, liability and restriction on grounds only of religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth or any of them.
final_answer: Therefore, Article 15 promotes equality by prohibiting discrimination.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding legal provisions and their implications on equality.

question_text: In what ways was Omprakash Valmiki’s experience similar to that of the Ansaris?
answer_text:
In following ways Omprakash Valmiki’s experience was similar to that of the Ansaris:
(i) Both of them discriminated by the society on the basis of their caste or religion.
(ii) Dignity and self respect of both of them get violated.
(iii) Both suffered from unequal treatment.
final_answer: Thus, both faced discrimination and violation of dignity due to societal biases.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of social issues and personal experiences.

subject: civics
question_text: What do you understand by the term "all persons are equal before the law"? Why do you think it is important in a democracy?
answer_text:
The term "all persons are equal before the law" means that everyone will be given justice before law by treating them equal. From the President of the country to the common people, all are equal in front of law. It is important in a democracy because:
(i) Democracy suggests that no one should be treated on unequal basis because of their wealth, caste, colour, religion, gender etc.
(ii) It also ensures that no one will be given more preference for the same crime.
(iii) It provide the people equal opportunity to defend themselves in public court irrespective of their socioeconomic position.
(iv) It also reflects the true nature of democracy.
final_answer: Therefore, equality before the law is fundamental to uphold justice and democracy.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding legal principles and their significance in democracy.
